# Image Studio — https://webp.shifros.com

Image conversion, resize, crop, rotate, flip. Output: WebP, JPG, PNG.
Browser only. No server. No HTTP API. Files never leave the device.

## Links

- [Image Studio](https://webp.shifros.com/): the app
- [Agent spec](https://webp.shifros.com/llms.txt): this file
- [Sitemap](https://webp.shifros.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Shifros](https://www.shifros.com/): publisher

## Choose a path

A. You can execute code (shell, Node, Python): do not use this site. Process locally.
B. You can only operate a browser: open this site and call the in-page API.

## A. Local

Node:

    npm i sharp
    node -e "require('sharp')('in.png').resize(800,600,{fit:'cover'}).webp({quality:80}).toFile('out.webp')"

Python:

    pip install Pillow
    python -c "from PIL import Image,ImageOps; ImageOps.fit(Image.open('in.png'),(800,600)).save('out.webp',quality=80)"

## B. Browser

Open https://webp.shifros.com. Run in the page:

    await ShifrosImageStudio.convert(input, { format: "webp", quality: 80, width: 800, height: 600 })

input: File | Blob | image URL (CORS required) | data: URL
returns: { blob, filename, format, mimeType, width, height, bytes, originalBytes, originalWidth, originalHeight, url, dataUrl? }
Downloads the file unless download: false.

Batch, one ZIP:

    await ShifrosImageStudio.convertAll([a, b, c], { format: "webp" })

Reference object: ShifrosImageStudio.describe()

### Options

format         "webp" | "jpg" | "png"            default "webp"
quality        1-100                             default 85; ignored for png
width, height  1-16384 px
fit            "cover" | "contain" | "fill"      default "cover"; applies when both width and height are set
crop           { x, y, width, height } px        after rotate, before resize
rotate         0 | 90 | 180 | 270                clockwise
flip           boolean                           horizontal
upscale        boolean                           default false; with contain or a single side
suffix         string                            appended to filename
filename       string                            replaces source name
download       boolean                           default true
returnDataUrl  boolean                           default false
zipName        string                            convertAll only

cover: centre-crop to target ratio, output exactly width x height.
contain: fit inside width x height, keep ratio.
fill: stretch to width x height.
One side only: scale to that side, keep ratio.

### Limits

64 MP per image. 16384 px per side. Animated input: first frame. JPG: transparency becomes white.

### Link presets

https://webp.shifros.com/?format=webp&quality=80&width=1200&height=1200&suffix=-web
Keys: format, quality, width, height (max box, keep ratio), suffix. Files are still added by the user.

### WebMCP

If navigator.modelContext exists, tool "convert_image" is registered. Params as above; image_url replaces input.
